name: Employer-Sponsored Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Under Law 6.984/2022 and the Labour Code, a foreign national hired by a registered Paraguayan company (with an active RUC tax ID) can obtain a work permit through the Ministry of Labour, Employment and Social Security (MTESS), processed 1-2 months after Temporary Residency is separately granted. No profession-specific restrictions or labor-market test/quota was found. Required: a notarized employment contract, the employer's tax and incorporation documents, plus standard residency documents (passport, criminal background check, medical certificate, proof of financial solvency). The permit is tied to the sponsoring employer -- changing jobs requires a new authorization. Fees: approximately USD 130 for the work permit itself, plus USD 350 for the separately-required Temporary Residency.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a notarized employment contract with a registered Paraguayan employer, obtain Temporary Residency, then apply for the work permit through MTESS.

evidence_required.document: Medical certificate and criminal background check
